text: Markets whose trades do not depend on physical location evolved without centralized coordination, as shown by the foreign exchange market, which developed decentralized because currency trading required no physical location.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization and Feedback Effects (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808852
abstract: For example, the foreign exchange (FX) market evolved without centralized coordination because currency trading did not require a physical location.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: holds where physical location is not determinative for the trade
